correctness.rationale: For 0<δ<1, all coalition surpluses are nonnegative, and applying the per-coalition cap to each pair yields v_ij≥0; hence the grand coalition is Nash stable. Summing W(S)≤2P(S)/(1−δ) over partition blocks proves W(grand)≥(1−δ)SW(opt). A three-player family has only r({1,2})=δ; its five partition welfares are 1−δ+2ε, 1, ε, ε, 0. Positive v_ij make every nongrand partition unstable via a singleton entry. Thus PoS=1/(1−δ+2ε) tending to the universal bound. Two-player case has grand coalition welfare optimum. The standalone exact rational checker passed 2245 instances but the proof is analytical.
